song.title: Faithfulness
song.lyrics:
[C1] Your mercies are new every morning Your steadfast love will never end This hope won't fade in the evening Lord, how great is Your faithfulness Lord, how great is Your faithfulness
[V1] Every hour Every minute of my life Has been part of Your design Lord, the whole world's in Your hand
[V2] Every trial Every battle that I face God, You've met me there with grace Every part has served Your plan
[P1] Through it all You've been so, so good Kept Your word Like You said You would
[C2] Your mercies are new every morning Your steadfast love will never end This hope won't fade in the evening Lord, how great is Your faithfulness Lord, how great is Your faithfulness
[V3] Here and now Looking back on where I've been Still as good as You were then There's no limit to Your love
[P2] Through it all You've been so, so good Kept Your word Like You said You would
[C3] Your mercies are new every morning Your steadfast love will never end This hope won't fade in the evening Lord, how great is Your faithfulness Lord, how great is Your faithfulness
[B1] Oh how great, oh how great Lord how great is Your faithfulness x2
[P3] Through it all You've been so, so good Kept Your word Like You said You would x2
[C4] Your mercies are new every morning Your steadfast love will never end This hope won't fade in the evening Lord, how great is Your faithfulness
[C5] Your mercies are new every morning Your steadfast love will never end This hope won't fade in the evening Lord, how great is Your faithfulness Lord, how great is Your faithfulness Lord, how great is Your faithfulness
song.author: Lakewood church
